situation.note: The controller rung, as the replay names it.

stop_p90.note: Worst joint's stop error, p90 over holds: the producer's score on this replay (ur5e.json rungs.<rung>.<joint>.score: the coordinated workload, every joint on its own held-out tape at once). Picked, never recomputed.
